I was not disappointed :) 4000 year old pice of history from 40,000 ft. in the air was instant goosebumps!! 

I was sitting on the left side of the aircraft. Have you seen such a beautiful view ever ?

Follow my page if you love travelling!

#aviation #indiatravelgram #egypt #pyramid #qatarairways".
